children: ARMAH SPORTS COMPANY SJSC - SIGNS LAND LEASE TO DEVELOP SPORTS CLUB IN RIYADH

ARMAH: PROJECT IS EXPECTED TO BE COMPLETED WITHIN TWO YEARS
